title: Restriction of a single-source cocycle through exact strict-local functors
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $s$ a geometric point, $g:S_{(s)}\to S$ its strict-henselization structural map, $K$ a bounded-below derived abelian etale sheaf, $L$ any cochain complex, $r:K\cong QL$, $n\in\mathbf Z$, $W$ etale over $S$, and $f:\mathbf Z[W]\to L^n$ a cycle. Let $\tau:\operatorname{sections}_W\to g^{-1}\circ\Gamma(S_{(s)},-)$ be any natural transformation. Use [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison] for the free-source Hom complex and degreewise evaluation, [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction] for exact strict-local global sections, and [lem-weil-pbc-source-localized-cocycle-homology] for the constructed homology section (its definition does not require K-injectivity). Apply homology to the evaluated Hom-complex class, localize its degreewise image under $\tau$, factor exact global sections and inverse image through localization, transport by $r^{-1}$, and commute exact global sections with homology. The resulting element equals $\tau$ applied to the homology section of $f$, followed by the bounded-below exact-inverse-image homology comparison. No K-injectivity, stalk, or base-change mate is assumed.

proof.text: Supply exact global sections for the original affine-neighbourhood colimit scheme using strictHenselizationScheme_globalSections_preservesFiniteColimits, proved from strictHenselizationLocalStructure and the terminal-sections theorem. Compute the cocycle class using leftHomologyData.π_comp_homologyIso_inv. Apply the chain map given by sourceFreeSectionsComplexIso followed by the degreewise transformation τ. For an exact functor, ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom and mapHomologyIso_eq identify the mapped homology projection with the mapped original projection after mapCyclesIso. Apply this for inverse image U and strict-local sections G. The composite cycle inclusion is G.map (U.map (L.iCycles n)); it is monic. Cancel this inclusion to identify the mapped cycle with τ applied to free-generator evaluation of L.liftCycles f. This follows from cyclesMap_i, cyclesIso_inv_comp_iCycles, Cochain.fromSingleEquiv_fromSingleMk and naturality of τ for L.iCycles n. Naturality for L.homologyπ n now gives the restriction identity before localization.

Prove the generic exact-functor transport identity: the inverse homology localization factorization, followed by homology of F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv and F.mapDerivedCategory.map t, then the inverse derived homology comparison, equals the complex homology comparison followed by F.map of the original localized homology transport. Use naturality of mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso.inv at t, cancel its hom component, and apply mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso_hom_app_Q. Apply this identity first to G and then to U, postcomposing the latter identity with its hom comparison. Naturality of homologyFunctorFactors.inv for the degreewise transformation τ removes Q.map from that map.

The bounded-below homology comparison is the unbounded comparison restricted along the inclusion, since mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility is Iso.refl. Substitute the restriction calculation of step 1 into the transport calculation of step 2. Use naturality of τ for b = homologyFunctorFactors.inv.app L followed by Hⁿ(r.inv), and sourceFreeSectionsEquiv_comp, to obtain the explicitly constructed sourceCocycleHomologySection. No K-injectivity or localized-cocycle comparison theorem is used, only the definition of that section.

Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.
